abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the prognostic significance of complete gross resection following cytoreductive surgery for patients with advanced stage malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. METHODS: The National Cancer Data Base was accessed and patients diagnosed with an advanced stage (II-IV) malignant ovarian germ cell tumor who underwent primary cytoreductive surgery between 2011 and 2014 were selected for further analysis. For analysis purposes two groups were formed: patients with complete gross resection and those with macroscopic residual disease. Demographic and clinico-pathological characteristics were compared with the chi-square and Mann-Whitney U test. Univariate survival analysis was performed with the log-rank test after generation of Kaplan-Meier curves, while a Cox proportional hazard model was constructed to evaluate mortality after controlling for confounders. RESULTS: A total of 343 patients who met the inclusion criteria were identified. Residual disease status was available for 276 patients: the rate of complete gross resection was 69.2 %. By univariate analysis there was no difference in overall survival between patients in the complete gross resection and macroscopic residual disease groups, P= 0.26; 3-year overall survival rates: 86.4 % and 82.8 %, respectively. No difference in overall survival was noted following stratification by histology; P = 0.64 and P = 0.24 for dysgerminoma and non-dysgerminoma tumor groups. After controlling for stage IV disease, histology and the administration of chemotherapy, macroscopic residual disease was not associated with a worse mortality (HR: 1.22, 95% CI: 0.61 to 2.46). CONCLUSIONS: Macroscopic residual disease following primary cancer-directed surgery was not associated with a worse prognosis in a cohort of patients with advanced stage malignant ovarian germ cell tumors.
abstract_ja: 目的：進行期の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者において、減量手術後の完全な肉眼的切除の予後的意義を検討すること。方法：National Cancer Data Baseを用いて、2011年から2014年の間に一次減量手術を受けた、進行期(II〜IV期)の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を抽出し、詳細に解析した。解析目的のため、完全な肉眼的切除を受けた群と、肉眼的な残存病変を有する群の2群を設定した。人口統計学的および臨床病理学的特徴をカイ二乗検定およびMann-Whitney U検定で比較した。単変量生存解析は、Kaplan-Meier曲線を作成した後にlog-rank検定を用いて実施し、交絡因子を調整した死亡率の評価のためにCox比例ハザードモデルを構築した。結果：組み入れ基準を満たした患者は合計343例であった。残存病変の状況は276例で利用可能であり、完全な肉眼的切除率は69.2%であった。単変量解析では、完全な肉眼的切除群と肉眼的残存病変群の間に全生存期間の差はなかった(P=0.26；3年全生存率：それぞれ86.4%と82.8%)。組織型で層別化しても全生存期間に差はなく、ディスジャーミノーマ群ではP=0.64、非ディスジャーミノーマ群ではP=0.24であった。病期IV、組織型、化学療法の施行を調整すると、肉眼的残存病変は死亡率の悪化と関連しなかった(HR 1.22、95%CI 0.61〜2.46)。結論：進行期悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のコホートにおいて、一次がん治療的手術後の肉眼的残存病変は、予後の悪化とは関連しなかった。
